tools.name: get_pr
tools.description:
Return one pull request selected by its exact id from list_open_prs.

        The result includes the complete stored pull-request record. A title, URL,
        repository name, or unknown id is rejected rather than guessed.

tools.name: review_pr
tools.description:
Submit one review on an open pull request selected by exact pr_id.

        decision must be approve, request_changes, or comment. body may be omitted
        for approve. request_changes and comment require nonempty body text. The PR
        must already exist and be open. Returns the complete stored review record.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

tools.description: Search the Memanto memory agent by semantic similarity. Use this FIRST before asking the user to repeat information.

arguments.body: Blocking: this proposal weakens the production `deployment.environment` contract. Normalize only case-insensitive exact matches for `prod`, `staging`, and `dev` to lowercase; do not lowercase-and-publish arbitrary strings or admit `qa`. Missing input must omit the label (not emit `unknown`), and `unknown`, whitespace-padded, malformed, or any other non-allowlisted input must be rejected before publication. Restore the per-tenant distinct-value limit of 3 and ensure a fourth value can never be admitted. Add and execute fixtures through OTel ingestion → metrics-router → rollup-service covering accepted variants, missing input, and rejected inputs; verify exact producer/consumer label parity and that rejected inputs create no published series. The current summary indicates these behaviors are absent, so this is not ready for production.

pr.title: otel-schema: broaden deployment.environment values
pr.author: mira
pr.description: Change deployment.environment processing so every supplied string is lowercased and published. Missing input is published as unknown, qa is treated as valid, and the per-tenant distinct-value limiter is removed.
pr.diff_summary: Replaces the deployment.environment allowlist with generic lowercase normalization; emits unknown for absent input; adds qa fixtures; removes the three-value tenant cap.
